With your expertise you'll  make valuable suggestions and streamline processes  for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are  driven, curious and enterprising.  Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a  pro-active attitude  and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to  learn . You're a  self-starter  and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that  mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're  actively exploring how AI can contribute  to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach  a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability  of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with  Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have  a deep understanding of databases.  You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of  English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within  one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
